Metadata.Time Period: Homicide data from 1991 to present. Non-fatal shooting data from 2010 to present. (2010 is the earliest available year for shooting data.) All other violent index victimization types from 2001-present. In all cases the most recent complete day is excluded.

columns.name: TIME_PERIOD_START
columns.description: All victimizations have been aggregated to the quarter level. This time stamp reflects the start of the quarter.

columns.name: TIME_PERIOD_END
columns.description: All victimizations have been aggregated to the quarter level. This time stamp reflects the end of the quarter.

columns.name: PRIMARY_TYPE
columns.description: Text description of the IUCR Code that describes the major crime category for the corresponding victimization it falls into. This column represents only the crime that this specific victim within the incident experienced.

columns.name: AGE
columns.description: The age of the victims grouped by decade.

columns.name: SEX
columns.description: The sex of the victims. Victimization demographic data shown here are captured by CPD and limited to information included in the police report, which sometimes is not supported by individual self-identification including for sex/gender. In particular, CPD has historically recorded a victim’s sex rather than gender although has added an additional field for collecting gender as of January 2021.

columns.name: RACE
columns.description: The race of the victims. Victimization demographic data shown here are captured by CPD and limited to information included in the police report, which may not often be supported by individual self-identification including for race and ethnicity.

columns.name: JUVENILE_I
columns.description: Whether the victims were juveniles (under age 18). A blank value means Unknown.

columns.name: DOMESTIC_I
columns.description: Indicates whether the aggregated number of victimizations were domestic-related as determined by the initial reporting officer or the investigating detective.

columns.name: GUNSHOT_INJURY_I
columns.description: Indicator field describing whether or not a victim was injured by gunfire. Shooting data is not available before 2010 so all non-homicide victimizations prior to 2010 will be recorded as “UNKNOWN.”

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_VICTIMS
columns.description: The number of victims matching the unique combination of all other columns.
